subject: Does INLA allow Gamma priors for fixed effects?

messages.author: 64ddc2708a5e8ffb
messages.subject: Does INLA allow Gamma priors for fixed effects?
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I am new to INLA (and am finding it difficult to find a direct answer to this question in existing threads). I have a covariate, vector abundance, that I am using to predict the probability of infection. I would like to set a prior estimate (see code below), while also restricting the posterior to positive values. Does INLA directly allow Gamma priors for fixed effects, as opposed to the Gaussian default?

inla(serology ~ vector_abundance,
                   data = df, family = 'binomial', control.family = list(link = "logit"),
                   control.fixed = list(mean=list(vector_abundance=0.470),
                                        prec=list(vector_abundance=1/(0.166^2))),
                   control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, config = TRUE)
                   )

Thank you very much,

Katie

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Does INLA allow Gamma priors for fixed effects?
parts:
You can bound regression coefficients using the ‘clinear’ model; see inla.doc(“clinear”)
